title: Implicit type conversion
claim: Comparing a column with a value of another type converts the column on every row and kills index usage.
verdict: Different in PostgreSQL, and mostly safer. Comparing a varchar column with an integer is an error, not a silent
conversion, and a quoted '4000000' against a bigint column is typed as bigint and uses the index. The real trap
is a numeric value: id = 4000000.0 converts every id to numeric and scans all 5M rows ({t:numeric_literal} vs
{t:int_literal}, {x:numeric_literal/int_literal}). Explicit casts on the column (id::text) do the same. Watch

sections.label: varchar column compared with an integer: PostgreSQL refuses instead of converting silently
sections.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM metric WHERE consumerid = 7;
sections.output:
ERROR:  operator does not exist: character varying = integer
LINE 1: SELECT count(*) FROM metric WHERE consumerid = 7;
                                                     ^
HINT:  No operator matches the given name and argument types. You might need to add explicit type casts.

sections.plan_text: Index Scan (metric_pk) | cond (id = 4000000) | rows=1 (est 1) loops=1 time=0.016 ms | buffers hit=7 read=0
sections.label: int_literal
sections.sql: SELECT id, date_c, url FROM metric WHERE id = 4000000;

sections.plan_text: Index Scan (metric_pk) | cond (id = '4000000'::bigint) | rows=1 (est 1) loops=1 time=0.012 ms | buffers hit=4 read=0
sections.label: string_literal
sections.desc: id = '4000000' (quoted literal is typed as bigint, index still used)
sections.sql: SELECT id, date_c, url FROM metric WHERE id = '4000000';

sections.plan_text:
Gather | rows=1 (est 25163) loops=1 time=218.208 ms | workers=2 | buffers hit=16096 read=111885
  -> Parallel Seq Scan (metric) | filter ((id)::numeric = 4000000.0) | rows=0 (est 10485) loops=3 time=201.721 ms | removed by filter=1677505 | buffers hit=16096 read=111885
sections.label: numeric_literal
sections.desc: id = 4000000.0 (numeric value: the column is converted to numeric)
sections.sql: SELECT id, date_c, url FROM metric WHERE id = 4000000.0;
